## Description

Measure end-to-end latency (stop → upload complete → transcription → draft → callback) on synthetic 5/10/15-minute consultations; optimise (parallel chunk upload, streaming transcription where approved, prompt size). Add telemetry and alert on p50 > 60 s.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** p50 ≤ 60 s and p90 recorded for 10-minute consultations on staging.
- [ ] **AC2.** Latency dashboard and alert exist (no PHI).

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
